steps.title: Arrive & introduce
tips: Present this as a free owner benefit, not a sales visit

steps.title: iRA.ev walkthrough

checklist.label: Showed how to find chargers on the map
Showed charge status and trip planner

tips: Let the customer hold the phone and do every tap

steps.title: Drive to charger

checklist.label: Customer picked a nearby charger in iRA.ev

tips: Keep a backup charger ready; no phone use while customer drives

steps.title: Public charge

checklist.label: Customer started the session in iRA.ev
Customer stopped the session and unplugged
Payment done and receipt shown in app

tips: Record charger name, start %, end %, kWh and ₹; if the charger fails, move to the backup

checklist.label: Told customer a feedback link will come

dos: Be on time, and message the customer if you will be more than 10 minutes late.
Wear your ID and introduce yourself.
Let the customer operate the app. You guide.
Use simple words in the customer's language.
Check the charger in iRA.ev before leaving, and have a backup.
Tick the checklist as you go.
donts: Don't drive the customer's car. The customer drives.
Don't ask for or type the customer's UPI PIN, card details, OTPs or passwords.
Don't pay for the charge yourself or promise free credits.
Don't sell accessories, insurance or other products during the visit.
Don't ask for a good rating.
Don't tick steps that weren't done.
Don't leave the customer at a failed charger without a next step.

faq.action: Re-plug once, retry in the app, then try another connector
Customer tries another payment method; never use yours
Stop the session in the app, lock and unlock the car, wait 30 s
